2116669713430282667.en_summary: BREAKING: The FBI announces that North Korea was behind the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, now the largest hack in history. North Korean hackers were previously accused by the FBI of some of the biggest crypto hacks including the $1.5 billion Bybit attack last year and the 2022 theft of $620 million in cryptocurrency. North Korea is now responsible for both the first and second largest crypto hacks in history.
2116669713430282667.zh_summary: 突發：FBI 宣布北韓是 Binance 63 億美元駭客攻擊的幕後，現為史上最大駭客事件。北韓駭客先前被 FBI 指控一些最大的加密貨幣駭客，包括去年 15 億美元的 Bybit 攻擊與 2022 年 6.2 億美元加密貨幣盜竊。北韓現在負責史上第一與第二大加密貨幣駭客。
